description: Claude Code plugins by Parsa — startup validation, business strategy, and iOS design tooling. Persian and English.

plugins.name: venture
plugins.description: Business copilot suite: market research, competitor analysis, customer discovery, PMF assessment, GTM strategy, unit economics, and board-style review — chained through a shared per-venture workspace.
